Local council approves new park

The council voted on Tuesday to turn the old rail yard into a public park. Work starts next spring and should take two years.

Residents had campaigned for the change since 2019, collecting more than 4,000 signatures.

The plan includes a playground, a pond and a cycle path linking two neighbourhoods.
